verdict.rationale: Apple documents MLX, Core ML, Metal/PyTorch backend support explicitly targeting Apple Silicon GPU/Neural Engine, showing first-party AI stack support for the M4 Pro's compute units. However, there is no explicit mention of llama.cpp or ONNX Runtime support, no benchmarks/independent hands-on confirmation of local LLM inference performance, and the developer.apple.com llms.txt probe 404s. Missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp/ONNX Runtime documentation or compatibility statements, independent hands-on validation of local-AI runtime performance on M4 Pro specifically.
